comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-005 (medium, acceptance-first). Required set = low ∪ {unit-tests, acceptance-tests, regression} per risk-gate-matrix.md; requirement-traceability is not required at medium and is therefore omitted from this contract's checks array (matching this feature's own T-001.contract.json and the epic-159-pillar-c precedent). BACKFILL, recorded as such: T-005's PASS gate (reports/quality-gate/20260810T231458Z-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-T-005.md, Run ID RUN-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-qg-T-005-seq0673, reserved identity-ledger sequence 673, attempt 4, the post-escalation cycle RT-20260809-001 prescribes, review-context manifest reports/review-context/pending-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-sdd-evaluator-T-005-seq0673-manifest.json with 35 hash-verified inputs) predates this feature's contract/evidence-bundle closeout convention, so the Done flip recorded no pair; the seq0679/seq0680/seq0681 gates each recorded the resulting check-task-state debt as pre-existing and not attributable to their tasks. This pair is populated post-hoc on 2026-08-11 at HEAD c36a6cbb, following exactly the sanctioned T-006 closeout pattern (commit fc827c29): contract populated from the independent quality-gate evaluator's own verification results recorded verbatim in the seq0673 report, evidence bundle generated by plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/generate-evidence-bundle.sh, both re-validated by check-contract and check-evidence-bundle at creation time. The seq0673 gate itself: VERDICT PASS, zero Critical, zero Major, six Minor (recorded, non-blocking); the evaluator independently re-ran both suite runtimes (bash and pwsh tests/generate-registry-digest.tests.* -> pass=17 fail=0, exit 0 each), rebuilt all four fragment digests itself and matched the CLI, proved order/duplicate independence, killed seven mutants against a scratch copy (suite non-vacuity), verified canonicalizer delegation by import inspection plus byte-different NFC fixtures collapsing to one digest, exercised every fail-closed error path (all rc=1, stderr-only), confirmed sh/js/ps1 wrapper parity byte-identically, confirmed suite registration in both runners with the live .github/workflows/test.yml byte-unchanged, re-ran the shared-fixture regression suite (validate-capability-registry 27/0), and re-measured all 24 declared Outputs rows (0 stale, 0 missing, zero undeclared after attribution). Backfill-time re-execution at HEAD c36a6cbb, transcript at specs/epic-190-a2-capability-registry/verification/T-005/backfill-20260811-checks.log: both suites green again (sh 17/0 exit 0; ps1 17/0 exit 0), check-placeholders over the four generator files passed, check-risk T-005 passed. Honesty notes: (1) the committed green-sh.log/green-ps1.log are 14-check-era captures of a suite that now has 17 checks — the seq0673 gate recorded this as its Minor 2 and substituted its own 17/0 execution plus mutation analysis; the stale logs are intentionally NOT re-captured here because their bytes are hash-pinned by the T-005 implementation report's Outputs table, and RT-20260809-001 item 2 (re-capture) remains open as a documentation action; red_evidence below cites the genuine 14-check-era RED captures. (2) The task-state-check row asserts the validity of T-005's own tasks.md row (Done with Approval, this very pair present), which every future check-task-state run re-verifies mechanically through this contract and bundle; at gate time the repo-wide tool exited 1 solely on the then-missing T-005/T-007 pairs — the debt this backfill clears — and with both pairs present check-task-state exits 0, measured at backfill time and recorded in the backfill commit.
